description: Extensions, FDWs, and external boundaries catalogue scenarios
comment: Table-driven pack for Extensions, FDWs, and external boundaries. Shared project template; each scenario overlays one declarative file.

scenarios.description: apply extension.create with a native in-place operation
scenarios.comment: Covers PG-CAT-EXT-01::extension.create. Keep public.transition_anchor identity stable.

forbiddenMigrationPatterns.description: does not replace the transition anchor
